data.text: WIN Christmas Bundle with Morphée and My 1st Years worth over £300!

data.alt: Morphée x My 1st Years Christmas competition banner

data.html:
‘Tis the season for an amazing competition and an enchanting journey into dreamland!

We’ve teamed up with Morphée and My 1st Years for your chance to WIN the ultimate Christmas bundle for little ones – a personalised My Little Morphée worth £90 and a £250 Gift card from My 1st Years.

It’s not just a sleep aid; it’s a portal to dreamy adventures! My Little Morphée is the enchanting bedtime companion that everyone is talking about.

With 192 captivating tales, playful visualisations, gentle breathing exercises, and soothing guided meditations, My Little Morphée helps little listeners nod-off peacefully or enjoy moments of calm in the day.

From magical islands to mysterious forests, your little ones choose their dream destination and the animal friend who will guide them there. This magical box of tales will transport them to a world where ‘all is calm’ this Christmas.

Our WINNER will receive a personalised My Little Morphée and a £250 My 1st Years Gift Card for the ultimate Christmas spending spree!

Choose from personalised stockings and Christmas Eve boxes, to beautiful wooden toys, wish list pressies and extra special gifts for baby’s first Christmas.

Make this holiday season truly magical with My Little Morphée.
To enter, simply pop in your details below by 3rd December 2023 and we will pick one lucky winner at random.

panels.title: Terms & conditions
panels.paragraphs:
The Prize Draw is open to UK residents only aged 18 and over.

Employees, their families, agencies or associates of Annabel Karmel, Morphée, My 1st Years and any third parties involved in the preparation and/or performance of this Prize Draw are not eligible for entry.

The Prize Draw closes at 10am on 3rd December 2023.

One winner will receive a personalised My Little Morphée sleep aid and £250 Gift Card from My 1st Years.

The winner will be contacted by 5th December 2023.

The winner must confirm acceptance and supply their address within 5 days of receipt of the prize email. In the instance of the winner not responding within 5 days, they will be deselected and a new winner will be selected at random and contacted. The same time frame for acceptance applies.

The prize bundle cannot be exchanged for cash.

Any personal details provided as part of the Prize Draw will be processed in accordance with Karmel & Co Limited’s privacy policy.

Annabel Karmel reserves the right at any time to cancel, modify or supersede the Prize Draw (including altering prizes) if, at its sole discretion, a Prize Draw cannot be conducted as specified.

Annabel Karmel reserves the right to substitute a prize of equal value in the event that circumstances beyond its control make this unavoidable.

This Prize Draw is operated by Karmel & Co Limited, 18A Pindock Mews, London W9 2PY, (“Annabel Karmel”).

data.text: WIN a pair of exclusive Taylor Swift the Eras Tour tickets at Wembley Stadium

data.alt: Taylor Swift The Eras Tour at Wembley Stadium

data.html:
It’s time to grab your bestie, book a babysitter, and get your Swiftie style on! We have two of the hottest seats in the house (or should we say stadium) this summer!

Annabel Karmel has partnered with luxury event curators Sensus Collective and MATILDE Jewellery to giveaway a pair of premium hospitality tickets to see Taylor Swift The Eras Tour at Wembley Stadium on Monday 19th August 2024.

And to mark your trip of an era, you’ll also WIN a pair of stunning friendship bracelets from Matilde Jewellery for you and your lucky guest!

MATILDE’S stunning pieces are made using only the finest recycled 14ct gold and lab-grown diamonds. By creating a sustainable alternative, MATILDE offers customers the opportunity to wear beautiful jewellery with a matching sparkling history.

panels.title: Terms & Conditions
panels.paragraphs:
Eligibility: The Prize Draw is open to UK residents only, aged 18 and over.

Exclusions: Employees, their families, agencies or associates of the organizing company and any third parties involved in the preparation and/or performance of this Prize Draw are not eligible for entry.

Closing Date: The Prize Draw closes at 11:59pm on 29th July 2024.

Winner Notification: The winner will be contacted by 1st August 2024.

Acceptance of Prize: The winner must confirm acceptance and supply their email address within 7 days of receipt of the prize notification email. If the winner does not respond within 7 days, they will be deselected, and a new winner will be chosen at random and contacted. The same time frame for acceptance applies.

Prize Details: The prize is x2 Taylor Swift tickets for the concert at Wembley Stadium on Monday, 19th August 2024. Tickets will be shared with the winner by email a week before the concert.

Non-exchangeable: The winners names will be included on the tickets. The prize cannot be exchanged for cash.

Data Processing: Any personal details provided as part of the Prize Draw will be processed in accordance with the organising company’s privacy policy.

Right to Modify: The organising company reserves the right at any time to cancel, modify, or supersede the Prize Draw (including altering prizes) if, at its sole discretion, a Prize Draw cannot be conducted as specified.

Prize Substitution: The organising company reserves the right to substitute a prize of equal value in the event that circumstances beyond its control make this unavoidable.

Non-transferable: The prize is non-transferable, non-negotiable, not for resale, and there is no cash alternative.

Conditions of Entry: The organising company reserves the right, in its absolute discretion, to refuse entry and to alter or cancel the Prize Draw for any reason.

Standard Terms: Standard terms and conditions apply.
